plan.title: Treated vs control adipose DE, sex- and age-adjusted
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a gene-symbol-indexed raw integer count matrix from Salmon (12,000 genes x 12 samples, counts.csv) with a 12-row sample table (metadata.csv) carrying condition (treated/control, 6 vs 6), sex (F/M) and age (years). The question is which genes differ between treated and control, with the explicit complication that the groups are unbalanced on age and that sex varies. That dictates the design: sex and age enter the negative-binomial model as fixed-effect design terms alongside condition (~ sex + age_c + condition), age mean-centred before the fit, rather than being regressed out of the counts beforehand — a two-step removal would borrow condition signal in an unbalanced design and overstate confidence.

T1S1 establishes sample structure before any test: blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes coloured by condition, sex and age, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes. With 12 samples this is also the only chance to see whether age or sex, not treatment, dominates the leading variance axis. T1S2 quantifies that directly with variancePartition on voom log-CPM, giving the share of each gene's variance attributable to condition, sex and age plus the condition~age association in the metadata — this is the diagnostic that tells the reader how much of the DE result is age-adjustment-dependent, and it is the step that answers the user's stated concern about age imbalance. T1S3 is the primary test: minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group size), median-of-ratios size factors inside the model, DESeq2 Wald test on the covariate-adjusted design, apeglm shrinkage of the condition coefficient, BH with independent filtering at alpha 0.05, p-value histogram inspected before adjustment. T1S4 refits the identical design with edgeR quasi-likelihood as an independent second method; at 6 per group the two tools agree on most genes but not all, so the intersection is the high-confidence set and the union is not reported as the result. T1S5 assembles the report with MA and dispersion plots, both shrunken and unshrunken log2 fold changes with standard errors, counts of genes with NA p-values split by cause (Cook's outlier flag vs independent filter), a sensitivity comparison of the adjusted model against an unadjusted condition-only fit, and the reproducibility record.

No enrichment step is planned: the research question asks which genes differ, not which pathways, and 12,000 gene symbols with 6-vs-6 replication is a thin basis for pathway claims. The plan is honest about power — 6 per group with two nuisance terms leaves 9 residual degrees of freedom, so a null result is weak evidence of no effect and effect sizes are imprecise; the report must say so.

~ sex + age_centered + condition with explicit reference level control
variancePartition mixed model on voom log-CPM: variance explained by condition, sex, age

steps.name: DE report with diagnostics and reproducibility record
steps.question: What is the reportable answer to which genes differ between treated and control adipose samples, with what diagnostics, thresholds, and stated limitations?
steps.description: Assemble the final report. Include: the method and version of each package; the design formula and the named contrast (condition, treated vs control); the thresholds (padj < 0.05, BH, independent filtering on, any lfcThreshold used); the number of genes tested after filtering and the number differentially expressed per method and in the intersection. Include the two fit diagnostics — the MA plot with significant genes marked and the dispersion plot — placed before the gene tables, plus the p-value histogram from T1S3. Include the variance-partition summary from T1S2 and the age/sex balance table from T1S1 so the reader can judge the adjustment. Include the adjusted-vs-unadjusted sensitivity comparison. Present the top genes ranked by the apeglm-shrunken log2 fold change, with the unshrunken estimate and lfcSE beside it and the shrinkage estimator named in the header. Volcano plot on the shrunken values. Close with an explicit power and limitation statement (6 vs 6, 9 residual df, age imbalance, gene-level counts without length offsets, gene symbols as identifiers) and the reproducibility record: sessionInfo, package versions, and any random seed.
steps.context: Final synthesis of the DESeq2 primary result, the edgeR confirmation, and the design diagnostics. This is the artefact a reader uses to judge whether the treated-vs-control calls survive the age imbalance the user flagged.
acceptance_criteria: Report names the method, package versions, design formula, the contrast as condition/treated/control, the thresholds, the number of genes tested, and the number of DE genes per method and in the intersection
MA plot and dispersion plot appear before the gene tables, each with a one-line statement of what it shows
p-value histogram and its shape are reported alongside the significant-gene count
Gene table carries log2FoldChange, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange, and lfcSE per gene, with the shrinkage estimator named; ranking and plots use the shrunken value
Adjusted-vs-unadjusted sensitivity comparison and the T1S2 variance fractions are included and interpreted
An explicit statement of power and limitations is present: 6 vs 6, residual degrees of freedom, age imbalance, absence of transcript length offsets
sessionInfo, package versions, and any seed are stored with the results
constraints: Rank genes and draw plots on the shrunken log2 fold change; keep the p-values from the unshrunken fit
Report the shrunken and unshrunken log2 fold change together with lfcSE — never the shrunken value alone and never a ranking on the unshrunken value alone
State the count of NA p-values from the Cook's outlier flag separately from those removed by independent filtering
Do not present the union of DESeq2 and edgeR calls as the result
Do not add pathway or gene set enrichment — the research question asks which genes differ, not which pathways
Do not overstate: if the significant-gene count is small or the p-value histogram is irregular, say so plainly rather than narrating the top genes
caveats: A gene whose significance depends on whether age is in the model is an adjustment-sensitive call and must be labelled as such
Interpreting individual top genes biologically is speculation at this sample size unless the effect is large and both methods agree

grounding.reason: Report contents fixed by R-0041@059a (method, versions, design, thresholds, counts), R-0085@c24d (shrunken and unshrunken LFC with SE, rank on shrunken), R-0087@c53d (MA and dispersion plots before the tables), R-0086@becf (reproducibility record), R-0042@54e1 (two-method overlap).
